tool_contracts.name: calculate_customer_metrics
tool_contracts.description: Return deterministic Customer 360 metrics grouped by business domain.

tool_contracts.name: create_retention_recommendation
tool_contracts.description: Create a deterministic, non-persisted draft recommendation from explicit evidence and current approved policy IDs. Never execute it.

tool_contracts.name: get_campaign_eligibility
tool_contracts.description: Return hard customer/channel blocks and review requirements; this does not claim final campaign or offer eligibility.

tool_contracts.name: get_customer_events
tool_contracts.description: Return bounded, identity-resolved customer events in an explicit lookback window.

tool_contracts.name: get_customer_profile
tool_contracts.description: Return the PII-safe customer profile and semantic-layer as-of time.

tool_contracts.name: get_purchase_history
tool_contracts.description: Return bounded customer orders and product-line evidence in an explicit lookback window.

tool_contracts.name: search_knowledge_base
tool_contracts.description: Search only current, approved knowledge documents using a bounded deterministic lexical index.
